shared_elements: figures rendered in low relief in profile view
overlapping or superimposed figures on a single relief field
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief figures shown in strict profile, and each includes an animal form, but that is about as generic as relief iconography gets. A shows a crowded horizontal narrative field of overlapping animal bodies with a naturalistically modelled maned head and curling locks, whereas B is a single vertical panel dominated by one schematic, blocky standing human wearing a headdress and holding an object, with no narrative crowding.
